sources.entry: nnScreenshots - Capture periodic screenshots to review your day and fill timesheets.

summary.name: nnScreenshots
summary.one_liner: A macOS app by Near North Software that takes periodic background screenshots so you can review your day and fill in timesheets.
use_cases: Reviewing how you spent your workday
Filling in timesheets from recorded activity
Creating PDF time reports for clients or invoices
Exporting time entries to ClickTime or CSV
summary.what_it_does: nnScreenshots runs in the background on macOS and captures screenshots periodically, storing them as a visual record of your day. A timeline interface lets you scrub through the day like a video and see gaps in activity. It includes built-in timesheet entries that can calculate task durations automatically and export them. Users can create and export PDF reports of time entries, and use built-in bundles for ClickTime and CSV export or write custom export bundles. Old screenshots are cleaned up automatically based on a chosen retention period, and the app estimates how much disk space they will use.
notable: Timeline view to scrub through screenshots of your day like a video
Built-in timesheet entries with automatic duration calculation and ClickTime/CSV export
Custom export bundles for other timesheet formats
Automatic cleanup of old screenshots with estimated disk usage
caveats: Priced at $19.99 (page notes a price reduction), with a 45-day free trial
Tested on macOS Mojave and several recent Mac OS X releases; no newer macOS versions named on the page
Use is subject to the Near North Software Products license
